title: Traditional Venezuelan Empanadas
description: A classic Venezuelan dish, these empanadas are filled with a delicious mixture of ground pork and spices, wrapped in a flaky crust.

ingredients.name: Ground Pork
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cook the pork to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C)

ingredients.name: Venezuelan Yeast
ingredients.notes: Available at most Latin American grocery stores

ingredients.name: Velvety Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use for brushing the empanada crust

ingredients.name: Empanada Dough
ingredients.notes: Available at most Latin American grocery stores

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground pork over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the Venezuelan yeast, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each dough square.
Brush the edges of the dough with velvety olive oil.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with velvety olive oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
